text.text: Arduboy is a small open-source handheld console inspired by the Nintendo Game Boy. Released in 2015, it uses simple hardware and a monochrome display to encourage game development and programming. Games are created using Arduino-compatible tools and stored digitally on the device. The platform has a large homebrew community with hundreds of independently developed games, making it popular among hobbyists, developers, and retro gaming enthusiasts.
